items.title: Zelensky to press Trump on air defences while in Washington
items.description: Ukraine's leader is hoping to firm up US commitments to bolstering Kyiv's anti-ballistic missile defences, as Russia has escalated deadly attacks.

items.title: The cocaine superhighway from Ecuador to Europe - the BBC reports on gangs and the police fightback
items.description: The BBC goes on patrol with Ecuador's police, who are grappling with a huge surge in drug crime.

items.title: US walks out of UN Security Council meeting during France's remarks
items.description: The row sparked after the US joined North Korea and Russia in voting against extending the term of the UN high commissioner for human rights.

items.title: Seattle pays tribute to food festival shooting victims
items.description: Families grieved on Monday as they remembered the three people killed in a shooting at a food festival.

items.title: Zidane confirmed as France head coach
items.description: Former Real Madrid manager Zinedine Zidane has been confirmed as the head coach of the France national team.

items.title: Odyssey translator writes scathing review of Nolan film adaptation
items.description: The film has won rave reviews from film critics but a translator of Homer's work was less than impressed.

items.title: Ariana Grande sues hackers who leaked music and videos
items.description: The pop star is suing to discover the identity of hackers who obtained unreleased photos and songs.
